verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs claim per-shot camera control covering pan, tilt, zoom, dolly and handheld within multi-shot storyboarding, so creators can direct camera moves rather than accept the model's default motion. The evidence is a single line in the claimed docs, with no detail on how the controls work or whether they apply outside multi-shot mode. missing for 10: explicit orbit and static/locked-camera options, in-depth documentation of the camera-control interface or parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks

citations.quote: Multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control (pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, handheld) up to 6 cuts
